text: A strip of masking tape makes a handy label for freezer containers: write the contents and date on it, then peel it off cleanly when you wash the tub.
Ugly fruit can still make excellent jam: cooking softens blemishes and brings out flavour, while preserving a surplus gives misshapen produce a useful second life.
